data.name: Elemental Wizard
data.detailed_description:
Elemental Wizard is a fantasy strategy and progression game where you command armies of elemental golems and compete to become the ultimate master of the elements.

Begin your journey by choosing a core discipline—Fire, Water, Earth, or Wind—and expand your power by unlocking additional disciplines as you level. Gather resources, construct and train golems, and develop unique armies tailored to your preferred playstyle.

Progress through a full single-player experience featuring resource gathering, golem building, quests, and AI battles, or challenge other players in online multiplayer combat. Every victory earns experience, resources, and mastery progression that strengthens your elemental disciplines and unlocks powerful abilities.

Features:

• Choose and master four unique elemental disciplines
• Gather resources and build customizable golem armies
• Unlock additional disciplines through character progression
• Earn mastery experience and discover new abilities
• Fight strategic battles against AI opponents or real players
• Complete quests and challenges for additional rewards
• Develop multiple elemental specializations and army compositions
• Progress your wizard through long-term leveling and mastery systems

• Full single-player progression with optional online multiplayer

Whether you prefer commanding overwhelming elemental forces, experimenting with different discipline combinations, or competing against other players, Elemental Wizard offers a deep progression system and endless opportunities to grow your magical empire.
